about: Public works shown only in part: the nude parts of each source picture are blurred into a copy beside it, which the found works' manifest (Resources/Images/commons/manifest.json) lists in place of the source. Each region is an ellipse given as fractions of the picture's width and height: [left, top, right, bottom]. The licences of these sources (public domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA) allow a modified copy; the manifest entry and its caption say the copy is blurred, and CC BY-SA copies keep that licence. scripts/blur-images.py makes the copies; scripts/fetch-images.ps1 fetches each source and runs it.
